title: Invesco Mortgage Capital Inc. April 2026 Dividend Announcement and March 31, 2026 Financial Update
summary: Invesco Mortgage Capital Inc. (NYSE: IVR) (the "Company") today announced that the Company declared a cash dividend of $0.12 per share of common stock for the month of April 2026. The dividend will be paid on May 14, 2026 to stockholders of record at the close of business on April 27, 2026, with an ex-dividend date of April 27, 2026.
